title: B1 · L46 — Technology impact
topic: Technology and its impact on society
description: Vocabulario sobre tecnología y su impacto: AI, remote work, screen time, social media, digital detox, apps, online communication.

questions.prompt: Situación: lees un titular sobre AI en un periódico.
questions.question: What does 'AI' stand for?
questions.explanation: 'AI' = 'Artificial Intelligence' (inteligencia artificial). Sigla omnipresente desde 2023 con ChatGPT y demás. Se pronuncia /eɪ aɪ/ letra por letra. Colocaciones: 'AI tools', 'AI-powered', 'AI models', 'generative AI'. Verbo: 'to be AI-generated' (creado por IA).
examples: AI is changing many industries at incredible speed. → contexto actual
Many apps now use AI behind the scenes — even your keyboard. → uso invisible

questions.question: Complete: 'Many people work from ___ these days.'
questions.explanation: 'Work from home' (WFH) es colocación fija — nunca '*work from remote*' o '*work from distance*'. Alternativas: 'work remotely' (adverbio), 'remote work' (sustantivo). Error TOP del hispanohablante: '*work at home*' calcando 'trabajar en casa' — la preposición es 'from', no 'at'.
examples: I work from home three days a week — hybrid model. → arreglo laboral
Working from home has serious advantages if you have space. → matiz condicional

questions.statement: 'Screen time' is the amount of time you spend looking at digital screens.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. 'Screen time' = tiempo total ante pantallas (móvil, ordenador, TV, tablet). Concepto muy actual, especialmente en padres/educadores. Colocaciones: 'limit/reduce/track screen time', 'excessive screen time'. iOS y Android tienen apps oficiales llamadas 'Screen Time'.
examples: I try to limit my screen time — max 4 hours a day. → autocontrol digital
Too much screen time is bad for your eyes and sleep. → consecuencias

questions.text: Social media has changed the way we communicate with our friends and family.
questions.explanation: Nota 'social' /ˈsəʊʃəl/ con /ʃ/ suave. 'Has changed' con /z/ sonora + /d/ final. 'The way we' se enlaza rápido con 'we' débil. Estructura muy productiva B1: 'X has changed the way we + verb'. Perfecta para reflexionar sobre impacto de tecnología, ciencia o eventos históricos.
examples: Technology has changed the way we work — for better and worse. → matiz
Apps have changed the way we shop — everything's a tap away. → cambio conductual

questions.prompt: Tu amiga necesita descansar de pantallas todo el fin de semana.
questions.question: Complete: 'She's doing a digital ___ this weekend — no phones or computers.'
questions.explanation: 'Digital detox' = periodo sin dispositivos electrónicos para descansar mentalmente. Colocación moderna fija. 'Diet' es dieta alimentaria (falso amigo: aunque suene similar, no funciona aquí). 'Exam/cleaner' no encajan. Colocación: 'do/take a digital detox', 'need a digital detox'.
examples: I really need a digital detox — I'm doom-scrolling too much. → autodiagnóstico
A digital detox is great for your mental health. → beneficio comprobado

questions.prompt: Empareja cada término tecnológico moderno con su significado:
questions.explanation: Cuatro términos que definen la conversación tecnológica actual. Todos aparecieron o se popularizaron en la última década. Dominarlos permite participar en discusiones sobre bienestar digital, trabajo moderno y transformación social. Colocaciones típicas incluyen adjetivos: 'excessive screen time', 'full remote'.
examples: AI is transforming society at unprecedented speed. → transformación macro
Remote work is becoming more common in tech and finance. → cambio sectorial

questions.prompt: Tu ordenador va lento y necesita mantenimiento.
questions.question: Choose: 'I need to ___ my computer — it's very slow.'
questions.explanation: 'Update' = actualizar software o dispositivo. 'Download' (descargar) e 'install' (instalar) son fases distintas del proceso. 'Upload' es lo opuesto (subir). Error típico del hispanohablante: 'actualise' — no existe en inglés; se dice 'update'. Colocaciones: 'update software/apps/OS', 'security update'.
examples: I need to update my phone — three apps are asking. → contexto móvil
She updated her apps yesterday and now nothing works. → efecto secundario

questions.target: Technology has completely changed the way we work and communicate with others.
questions.explanation: Situación: opinas sobre impacto tecnológico en una discusión de grupo. Estructura potente B1: 'X has changed the way we + verb'. 'Completely' intensifica. Present perfect enfatiza cambio con efecto actual. Tono reflexivo, ni tecnofóbico ni tecno-optimista — balanceado.
examples: Technology has changed how we learn — YouTube tutorials for everything. → ejemplo concreto
Apps have changed how we travel — no more paper maps or phrasebooks. → cambio observable

questions.statement: 'To go viral' means to become suddenly popular on the internet.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. 'Go viral' = hacerse enormemente popular rápido en internet (metáfora de virus contagioso). Colocación fija moderna. Se aplica a videos, memes, publicaciones, personas. Verbo asociado: 'to blow up' (informal, mismo sentido). No confundir con 'to be trending' (estar de moda temporalmente).
examples: The video went viral in a day — 10 million views. → dato de alcance
Her tweet went viral last week — she had 500 followers before. → cambio drástico

questions.prompt: Explicas cómo empezar a usar una nueva app en el móvil.
questions.question: Complete: 'You need to ___ the app before you can use it.'
questions.explanation: 'Download' = descargar (traer datos de internet al dispositivo). 'Upload' es lo contrario (subir). 'Delete' es eliminar (invertiría la lógica). 'Close' es cerrar. Colocaciones: 'download an app/file/song', 'from the App Store / Google Play'. Verbo asociado: 'install' (instalar después de descargar).
examples: I downloaded a new productivity app yesterday. → contexto personal
The app installed automatically after I downloaded it. → proceso completo

questions.text: Working from home can be great but it also has its own set of challenges.
questions.explanation: Nota 'working' con /ŋ/ nasal. 'Home' con /əʊ/ (UK) o /oʊ/ (US). 'Its own' con posesivo (no confundir con 'it's' = 'it is'). 'Set of' se enlaza rápido. Estructura B1 clave para debate equilibrado: 'X can be great but it also has + set of challenges'. Muy natural para discusiones matizadas.
examples: Remote work has clear pros and cons — depends on your role. → dependencia contextual
Working from home is not for everyone — some people need the office energy. → matiz

questions.prompt: Identifica el efecto negativo del exceso de tecnología.
questions.question: Which is a NEGATIVE effect of too much technology?
questions.explanation: 'Sleep problems' — la luz azul de pantallas suprime melatonina y las notificaciones fragmentan el descanso. Las otras tres son beneficios reales. Vocabulario B1 asociado: 'blue light', 'sleep deprivation', 'insomnia'. Regla: los científicos recomiendan cero pantallas 1h antes de dormir.
examples: Too much screen time causes sleep problems, especially in teens. → grupo vulnerable
Phones can affect your sleep quality even from another room. → sutilidad del efecto

questions.statement: 'Cyberbullying' is bullying that happens online or through digital devices.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. 'Cyberbullying' = acoso digital (redes, mensajería, juegos online). Problema serio, especialmente entre menores. Sinónimo: 'online harassment'. Colocaciones: 'cyberbullying victim', 'report cyberbullying', 'cyberbullying awareness'. Muchos países tienen leyes específicas contra ello.
examples: Cyberbullying can have serious mental health effects. → consecuencia grave
Schools are teaching about cyberbullying prevention now. → respuesta educativa

questions.prompt: Confiesas que pasas demasiado tiempo con el móvil.
questions.question: Complete: 'I spend too much time ___ my phone.'
questions.explanation: 'Spend time ON + dispositivo/plataforma' es la preposición fija. Error TOP del hispanohablante: 'in my phone' (calcando 'en mi teléfono'). Colocaciones: 'on my phone', 'on the computer', 'on social media', 'on TikTok/Instagram'. Regla: superficies electrónicas usan 'on'.
examples: I spend hours on my phone every day — need to cut down. → autoreconocimiento
She's always on her computer, even at weekends. → observación de tercero

questions.target: Social media has both positive and negative effects on our daily lives.
questions.explanation: Situación: opinas de forma equilibrada en un debate sobre redes sociales. Estructura B1 clave: 'has both positive and negative effects on X'. Proyecta madurez analítica — no polarizas. 'Daily lives' es colocación fija natural. Contracción implícita, tono neutro y reflexivo, ideal para presentaciones.
examples: AI has both real benefits and serious risks — we need to talk about both. → llamada a debate
Screens have positive and negative effects on kids — moderation is key. → matiz educativo
